visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Extract a Superclass
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Dog and Cat contain the same name field and the same eat method. Move the shared parts into an Animal superclass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: Shared code belongs in the superclass: a fix to eat() now fixes every animal. Each subclass keeps only what makes it different.

tests.pattern:
(?<![\s\S])\s*Rex is eating[ 	]*?
Tom is eating[ 	]*?
Rex says Woof[ 	]*?
Tom says Meow\s*(?![\s\S])
